cases.summary: Customer Services asks for the customer MSISDN
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.input: 1. Open Customer Services from the dashboard.
cases.expected: Customer Services opens and asks for the customer MSISDN.

cases.summary: Valid MSISDN returns certification status and eligible actions
cases.preconditions: Accredited agent; valid customer MSISDN on staging
cases.expected: Certification status is shown. Eligible actions are displayed.

cases.summary: Invalid or inactive MSISDN shows the quoted message
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation; on Customer Services MSISDN entry
cases.expected: Message: "It seems the MSISDN entered is either incorrect or inactive."

cases.summary: POS / POA / Cash Point / Agent Account MSISDN does not offer Telco actions
cases.preconditions: MSISDN of an active POS, POA, Cash Point, or Agent Account
cases.expected: SIM Swap, Re-identification, and Upgrade Customer File are not allowed. Assert those three actions are absent (Q-001).

cases.summary: Non-accredited agent can view certification status
cases.preconditions: Non-accredited agent account; valid customer MSISDN
cases.expected: Certification status is visible.

cases.summary: Non-accredited agent sees no action buttons
cases.expected: No action buttons are displayed. SIM Swap, Re-identification, Upgrade Customer File, Subscribe to Mixx by Yas are absent.
cases.traceability: SAA-912; REQ-006, REQ-011; UI Behaviour — No action buttons displayed

cases.summary: Certified Telco + MFS shows SIM Swap only
cases.preconditions: Accredited agent; Certified Telco + MFS customer
cases.expected: SIM Swap is shown. Re-identification, Upgrade Customer File, Mixx by Yas are not.

cases.summary: Certified Telco Only shows SIM Swap and Mixx by Yas
cases.preconditions: Accredited agent; Certified Telco Only customer
cases.expected: SIM Swap and Mixx by Yas are shown. Re-identification and Upgrade Customer File are not.

cases.summary: Non-Certified shows SIM Swap, Re-identification, Upgrade Customer File
cases.expected: SIM Swap, Re-identification, Upgrade Customer File are shown. Mixx by Yas is not.

cases.summary: Status_Dossier 0-dossier allows SIM Swap/Re-identification and Upgrade Customer File
cases.expected: SIM Swap / Re-identification allowed. Upgrade KYC not allowed. Upgrade Customer File allowed.
